source_ref: Mad_Mage_Source.txt / Level 1 / 6. Undertakers' Watch Post / 6c. Uktarl's Room
test_precondition: The four occupants have not been encountered elsewhere and have not relocated to the alert position in 6a. This is a conditional snapshot, not the default result of entering from the Yawning Portal.
room_rules: The Undertakers' vampire disguises can be seen through with a DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check; the appearance alone is not proof.
The gang demands 10 gp per character for safe passage. If they cannot extort or defeat adventurers, they try to turn them against the Xanathar goblinoids.
Uktarl is a bandit captain with Performance +4. He lies and cheats for fun and blames others for his failures.
A character inspecting the mountain carving can locate the stone key with a DC 13 Wisdom (Perception) check.
If Uktarl takes damage or sees an underling slaughtered, he retreats toward area 7; the others flee toward area 8 and join any bandits still there.
The bandits do not know about the stone key or its use.
The DM map shows area 6c as approximately 20 by 30 feet, with one door on its south wall opening to a short passage. The table is near that door; the fresco and recessed tub are at the north end.

labels.area_06c: A door near the card table opens into the short passage to the south.
labels.south_passage: The door back into the card room.

card_table.text: Four pale figures with pointed teeth and elaborate clothing sit at a worn table playing cards; each has coins in front of them.

fresco.text: A carved mountain scene covers the north wall, with tiny dwarven figures in its caverns and rays of sunlight spreading outward.

tub.text: A stone tub about 8 feet long, 4 feet wide, and 2 feet deep is recessed into the floor beneath the carving.

treasure_on_table.text: Several stacks of coins and a silver ring rest on the table.

marked_deck.text: The dealer's card deck carries subtle marks.

fresco_key.text: One of the tiny carved dwarves can be lifted out; it is a stone key.

key_function.text: The stone key fits a box in area 14b; its purpose is not apparent from finding it here.

tub_stash.text: A bedroll, thieves' tools, and enough stolen gear to assemble one explorer's pack are stored in the tub.

table_treasure.text: A count of the table coins gives 220 copper, 91 silver, and 85 gold pieces; the silver ring bears dwarven fertility symbols and is worth 25 gold pieces.

uktarl.name: Pale man dealing cards
uktarl.motive: Profit from newcomers and displace Harria as leader of the Undertakers.
uktarl.immediate_goal: Control the encounter without risking himself.
knowledge: The Undertakers' vampire appearance is a disguise.
uktarl.retreat_condition: If damaged or if an underling is slaughtered, retreat toward area 7.

communication_profile.rhythm: Performer with a practiced front; blames others when pressed.
communication_profile.humor: Unspecified by source; derive from his cheating and self-importance only when the moment earns it.
